items.veto: 경영진 정직성 또는 회계 신뢰성 훼손

assessments.rationale: The supplied filings disclose established Audit Committee oversight, continued PwC engagement and related-party controls, and do not disclose a restatement, auditor dispute or material weakness. No primary evidence establishes the veto's required integrity/accounting-trust damage event.
cutoff까지 재작성·감사인 이견/교체·내부통제 중대결함 또는 미공시 관련자거래가 확인되지 않았다. 10-Q에서 disclosure controls가 effective로 평가됐다. Factoring과 XPV는 공시된 구조이므로 그 자체가 회계 신뢰 훼손 사건은 아니다.

Broadcom's own operations generate cash far above ordinary capex and near-term debt maturities, so the company does not require repeated external financing to operate. XPV financing supports customers and is routed to off-balance risk rather than this veto.
9M OCF $32.95B와 현금 $23.98B, 낮은 현행 capex, 미사용 $7.5B revolver는 AVGO 자체 영업이 필수 지출을 조달함을 보여준다. XPV는 고객 자금조달 지원 위험이지 AVGO 영업이 반복 외부자본 없이는 성립하지 않는다는 두 구성요건을 충족하지 않는다.
Q3 diluted shares increased only about 0.56% y/y while Broadcom repurchased $8.45B of stock in 9M. The 'excessive' element is not supported even though SBC remains material.

Diluted shares increased only about 0.56% y/y and 9M repurchases totaled $8.45B. Material SBC exists, but the 'long-lasting and excessive dilution' elements are not supported by the share-count evidence.

The veto requires absence of customer value plus subsidy dependence. Multi-generation design wins, non-terminable commitments, 69% gross margin and performance-per-watt evidence refute the required 'no customer value' element. XPV financing remains a unit-economics risk, not this veto by policy.
69% gross margin, multi-generation design wins, 비취소 계약/RPO와 AI revenue 성장은 ‘고객가치 부재’라는 필수 요건을 반증한다. XPV vendor-financing 위험은 정책상 CP/FS/AS에 남기며 이 veto와 분리한다.

Operating income and owner-FCF proxies are rising sharply while a simple invested-capital proxy increased only modestly. The exact incremental ROIC is noisy, but evidence contradicts a structural collapse below cost of capital.
RF는 operating income·owner-FCF가 invested-capital proxy보다 훨씬 빠르게 증가한다고 확인했고 incremental return을 75점 수준으로 평가했다. 자본비용 아래의 구조적 붕괴가 현재 관측됐다는 증거는 없다.

The veto requires actual and persistent shrinkage. Current evidence shows expanding AI revenue, improving consolidated gross margin, multi-generation design wins and tighter software contracts. Future customer insourcing is a monitoring risk, not evidence that the moat is already persistently shrinking.
현재 evidence는 AI revenue 가속, 69% gross margin, multi-generation design wins와 더 강한 software contract terms를 보여준다. 고객 자체실리콘은 중요한 미래 위협이지만 실제·지속적 moat shrinkage의 현재 증거는 아니다.

items.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구

assessments.rationale: Frozen price $357.61 is far below locked Bull value $797.84; the veto's sole element is not met.
Frozen price $357.61 is below locked-policy Bull value $797.84 and equals only 0.884x Base $404.48. The defined veto requires current price to exceed Bull value, which is not satisfied.
Frozen current price $357.61은 Bull value $797.84보다 크게 낮다. Base valuation의 야심과 Bear downside는 EV/AS 점수 문제지만 veto의 단일 구성요건인 현재가 > Bull은 성립하지 않는다.

items.veto: 단일 제품·단일 고객·단일 규제에 대한 치명적 종속성

assessments.rationale: Concentration is high and the distributor-level >25% watch trigger is met, but a distributor is a channel rather than a disclosed single end customer, and the filings show multiple end customers plus a separate software segment. A single dependency whose loss would irreversibly destroy business economics is not established.

Top-five end-customer concentration은 높지만 개별 end-customer >25%는 공시되지 않았고, 50% 수치는 distributor channel이다. Semiconductor 외 infrastructure software도 material하다. 집중위험은 크지만 단일 요인 상실 시 사업경제성이 회복 불가능하게 훼손된다는 fatality는 입증되지 않았다.

items.veto: 파산 또는 영구손실 확률이 기대수익에 비해 지나치게 높음

assessments.rationale: Bear valuation still assumes positive owner FCF and meaningful going-concern value, while current OCF and liquidity are substantial. The large Bear price drawdown is valuation risk, not evidence of business-value extinction; AI XPV commitments remain a scored tail risk.

Cash plus undrawn revolver, strong OCF and only $2.252B principal due within 12 months refute a material near-term bankruptcy probability. Large AI commitments remain a scored tail risk, not evidence that business value is likely to be extinguished.

basis.direction: 27개 전부 gpt-5.6-sol >= Claude Opus 5. 노이즈가 아니라 계통 편향.
basis.caveat: 표본은 종목 1개다. 다른 종목의 쌍 실행이 쌓이면 base_offset을 재추정해야 한다. harness.py calibrate로 측정한다.

dispersion_review.metric: scored 도메인 전체에 대한 skew = (score - bear_score) - (bull_score - score) 의 평균. 양수면 하방 폭이 더 넓다는 뜻이다.

financial_conditions.summary: Fed policy tightened on 2026-09-16 and real yields remain elevated; duration-sensitive assets face a restrictive discount-rate backdrop.

evidence.claim: FOMC raised the target range 25bp to 3.75%-4.00%.
September SEP median policy rate is 4.1% for end-2026 and end-2027; 2026 PCE/core PCE medians are 3.7%/3.4%.

credit_liquidity.summary: US high-yield spreads remain tight despite higher real yields, indicating functioning credit rather than broad liquidity stress.

evidence.claim: ICE BofA US High Yield OAS was 2.70% (270bp) on 2026-09-17.

ic_verdict.thesis: AVGO는 v3.1에서 Growth 유형을 통과했고 Hard Veto 9개도 모두 cleared다. 구조적 AI 성장, 주당 현금창출, 경영진 실행력은 강하지만 FS 70·MT 68·AS 68로 완성도는 아직 중간 수준이며, downside skew 11.17과 Bear $137.04가 현재가 $357.61 대비 큰 하방을 보여준다. $126.8B 구매약정, $29B XPV backstop, 조건부 $42B customer notes, factoring까지 감안하면 Growth 초기 상한 1–3%를 그대로 쓰지 않고 STARTER 1–2%만 승인하며 macro pacing 0.5로 분할 집행한다.

evidence.claim: Aggregate score is 70.46 (Emerging Outlier); Growth is the only eligible archetype with deterministic fit score about 72.64.
All nine Hard Vetoes are CLEARED after ED/RT review, and core coverage is 100%.
Locked valuation is Bear $137.04, Base $404.48, Bull $797.84 versus frozen price $357.61; price/Base is 0.8841x.
Dispersion review shows mean downside skew 11.17, one-band reduction, with valuation the widest domain and asymmetry the most downside-skewed.
Q3/9M primary evidence shows 69% gross margin, 9M OCF $32.95B and strong AI growth, but also $126.821B purchase commitments, a maximum $29B XPV backstop and $3.95B of 9M receivables factoring.
Macro overlay leaves fundamental score unchanged but sets purchase pacing to 0.5 because geopolitical energy/shipping stress is the binding overlay.

counterevidence: Current price is below Base value, so AVGO has more valuation support than many high-growth peers.
69% gross margin, fast AI revenue growth and strong OCF argue that current demand is economically real rather than purely narrative.
Multi-generation custom-XPU programs and software contracts provide visibility beyond a single quarter.
XPV backstop is contingent, had no payments at quarter-end and was not recorded at a material fair value.
unknowns: XPV-supported customers' share of total revenue and AR.
How much of $126.8B purchase commitments is matched to non-cancellable customer obligations.
Actual funded loss exposure and recovery economics of the $29B backstop and any customer notes.
Independent customer-level XPU TCO/payback and long-run gross margin.
Normalized OCF/owner-FCF after removing factoring and working-capital timing effects.
falsifiers: AI semiconductor growth falls below 30% for two consecutive quarters while gross margin drops below 65%.
XPV-supported revenue/AR exceeds 25% or funded backstop/customer-note exposure rises materially while cash conversion weakens.
Owner FCF/share falls below the locked Base path across multiple periods and a refrozen Base value no longer exceeds market price.

key_kpis.threshold: support-linked exposure <25%; no material funded loss

next_checks: Next 10-Q: XPV backstop, customer notes, purchase commitments, factoring and customer concentration.
Independent custom-XPU TCO/performance and customer payback evidence.
Refreeze valuation after FY2027 company guidance and normalized owner-FCF update.

plain_language.business: Broadcom은 데이터센터와 통신 장비에 들어가는 반도체, 맞춤형 AI 가속기와 네트워킹 칩을 만들고 VMware 기반 인프라 소프트웨어도 판매한다. 반도체와 소프트웨어 두 사업이 함께 현금을 만든다.
plain_language.opportunity: 현재 가장 큰 기회는 대형 AI 고객의 맞춤형 가속기와 이더넷 네트워킹 수요다. 장기 계약과 빠른 AI 매출 성장은 성장성을 뒷받침하고, VMware 소프트웨어는 별도의 현금흐름 원천을 제공한다.
plain_language.risk: 고객 집중이 높고, 대규모 구매약정과 AI 고객 지원 구조 때문에 AI 투자가 예상보다 둔화될 때 손실이 서로 겹칠 수 있다. 매출채권 factoring과 고객금융 구조 때문에 현금흐름의 질도 계속 확인해야 한다.
plain_language.decision_reason: 성장주 기준과 모든 중대 탈락 조건은 통과했지만 하방 시나리오가 넓고 재무·고객 집중 위험이 남아 있다. 그래서 초기 비중은 1~2% Starter로 제한하고, 현재 거시환경에서는 평소보다 절반 속도로 나눠 집행하는 결론이다.

archetype_rationale: Highest eligible deterministic fit; ties use configured priority
falsifiers: Bull asymmetry weakens materially if AI semiconductor growth falls below 30% while software growth also falls below 10% for two consecutive quarters.
Permanent-loss resilience weakens if backstop exposure becomes funded while TTM OCF falls below $25B or net debt exceeds 2x TTM OCF.
The concentration bear case weakens if top-five end-customer share falls below 40% without sacrificing AI growth.
Customer-value score falls if independent benchmarks fail to show a material TCO/performance advantage.
Retention score falls if RPO declines while termination rights return or VCF growth stalls.
Unit-economics score falls if funded XPV exposure rises materially while gross margin or OCF conversion deteriorates.
Disruption score should fall if AI semiconductor growth drops below 30% before custom XPU deployments diversify across at least three major end customers.
The cost-performance thesis weakens if independent benchmarks fail to show a material performance-per-watt advantage for custom inference accelerators.
Optionality weakens if infrastructure software growth falls below 10% and AI networking loses share while hyperscalers internalize more silicon.
다음 10-Q에서 XPV funded exposure·factoring·AR가 동시에 확대되고 gross margin/OCF conversion이 악화되면 현재 Growth 근거의 증거 품질을 하향한다.
개별 고객 또는 XPV 지원 매출 비중이 25%를 넘는 것으로 확인되면 CP/RT 집중·벤더금융 검토를 재실행한다.
frozen 재무팩과 원 공시 간 정의·기간·수치 충돌이 확인되면 해당 도메인과 EV를 재실행한다.
If FY2027 revenue is below $125B or owner FCF/share is below $11, the Base path should be cut materially.
If the top-five customer share rises above 60% while gross margin and contract visibility weaken, concentration risk should move from a monitoring item to a core valuation haircut.
If owner FCF/share reaches at least $17 by FY2028 while RPO remains above $150B and customer concentration does not worsen, the Bear case becomes materially less plausible.
Liquidity score should fall if TTM OCF drops below $25B while net debt exceeds 2x TTM OCF.
Off-balance risk becomes severe if funded backstop/customer-note exposure plus binding commitments exceeds 2x TTM revenue without matched non-cancellable customer commitments.
Dilution veto must be reconsidered if diluted shares rise more than 3% y/y for four consecutive quarters despite repurchases.
AI semiconductor growth falls below 30% for two consecutive quarters while gross margin drops below 65%.
XPV-supported revenue/AR exceeds 25% or funded backstop/customer-note exposure rises materially while cash conversion weakens.
Owner FCF/share falls below the locked Base path across multiple periods and a refrozen Base value no longer exceeds market price.
Capital-allocation score falls if future buybacks occur above 1.2x contemporaneous Base value without superior alternatives exhausted.
Execution score falls if VMware software growth stalls while restructuring/integration costs reaccelerate.
Governance score falls on a restatement, material weakness, auditor dispute or undisclosed related-party transaction.
Sustained oil/shipping normalization plus clear disinflation and a Fed pivot would justify restoring pacing toward 1.0.
HY OAS above 400bp or a material issuance freeze would justify reducing the financial multiplier below 0.7.
A sustained fall in 10-year real yields without weaker growth would reduce discount-rate pressure.
Moat trajectory weakens if a major customer shifts two generations away from Broadcom without replacement wins.
Switching/pricing score falls if gross margin compresses below 60% without an offsetting software mix change.
Ecosystem score rises only if Broadcom discloses repeatable scale/trend metrics rather than contract value alone.
Incremental-ROIC score falls if operating profit growth stalls while invested capital and commitments keep rising.
FCF/share quality falls if normalized owner FCF/share drops below FY2025's ~$4 level for two quarters.
Reinvestment-runway score falls if TTM absorption drops below 15% without an offsetting high-return acquisition program.
Top-five concentration이 45% 이하로 내려가고 AI growth가 50% 이상 유지되면 집중 기반 숏 논리는 크게 약화된다.
XPV funded exposure가 미미한 상태에서 factoring/OCF가 5% 아래로 내려가고 OCF margin이 유지되면 cash-quality 숏 논리는 약화된다.
독립 benchmark에서 Broadcom custom XPU/네트워킹이 고객 내부 대안 대비 지속적인 TCO 우위를 확인하면 기술대체 숏 논리는 약화된다.
Structural leadership weakens if AI semiconductor growth falls below 30% while RPO declines for two consecutive quarters.
Category leadership weakens if major customers move two consecutive accelerator generations away from Broadcom.
Durability score falls if infrastructure software drops below 10% of revenue or customer concentration exceeds 65% without offsetting diversification.
